title: Radial Hub: compact quick-jump with cost lenses & rollout timeline prototype
creator: Asha Raman
description: Problem: current workspace switching and route surface in the Console requires deep nested menus and context switching between dashboards, rollout panels and cost views. Goal: design a compact, discoverable quick-jump (Radial Hub) that sits above the left rail and surfaces contextual lenses for Cost, Rollouts, and Recent Dashboards without full navigation context switch. Scope: prototype for desktop + large tablet only; canonicalize interactions, keyboard shortcuts, and progressive disclosure for heavy users. Out-of-scope: mobile nav flows, backend routing changes (handled by ENG-3560).
acceptance_criteria: Clickable radial hub prototype that opens on cmd/ctrl+K or workspace avatar click
Radial slices present: Workspaces, Recent Dashboards, Cost Lenses, Rollouts, Bookmarks
Hover/preview overlay shows cost delta and active rollout timeline for selected item
Prototype includes keyboard navigation and accessibility labels
Design handoff files (Figma + spec) posted and ready for a 2-week engineering spike
decisions: Use radial layout to minimize left-rail real estate changes and preserve existing topography
Expose cost lenses as first-class lens rather than buried filters to increase discoverability
Preview overlays (lightweight) instead of full route navigation for quick inspection
Implement keyboard-first activation; fallback click target on avatar for mouse users
tasks: Finalize accessibility labels and focus-trap behavior (owner: Marta)
Create motion specs for radial opening/closing (owner: Asha)
Produce responsive breakpoints and an iteration for >1440px vs 1024-1439px
Sync with ENG on API for rollout timeline snippet (dependency ENG-3621)
